reviews.title: Company that charges you for check in
reviews.text: Their websites says just that the online check in OPENS 72 hours before departure. No single word about the closing time. We tried to check in over two hours before the departure (like all other flight companies accept), but the website just says it was closed. Therefore we had to check in manually at the airport, and the service desk charges you to check in at the airport. The company used over three months to came back to our claim and they just says that "we was too late". Too late for what? For the NON-CLOSING time? What a shtty company. First and last time with Eurowings.
reviews.author: Ole N

reviews.title: Horrible airline. Lost my luggage after charging me €50 extra
reviews.text: Luggage lost with no information of the location of the bag two-days later. First of all, the check-in process never gave me an opportunity to add any bags. Once I had checked-in, there was an option, but it warned me that changing anything would remove my check-in. Still, there was no information about what I would be allowed on the plane. Finally downloaded the app that said I had a small cabin bag (as opposed to other airlines that specify under-seat bag). Hours laters whilst trying to board, I'm told that I may not bring on my cabin luggage because I also have a small bag intended to be under my seat. I was forced to pay €50, and the bag was then lost. Still waiting on information.
reviews.author: Oskar B

reviews.title: Think before you book
reviews.text: The tittle says it all. Please dont fly with Eurowings Discover. Booked with Lufthansa, flight operated by Eurowings Discover to Mauritius from Amsterdam with a stopover in Frankfurt. We flew with an old a330-300 (former Lufthansa). We had seats at row 30, emergency exit, paid 100 euo’s extra per person one way, and we had enough space to stretch our legs. This was the only good experience with Eurowings Discover. The food was horrible. The grumpy staff said it was pasta or chicken, it looked and tasted much worse. Could not finish it. In general you feel welcome when you enter a plane, with Eurowings it was the total opposite. Grumpy staff without one single smile during the whole flight. Maybe they had a bad night, but i think you should be proffessional no matter what. 3 drinks during the whole flight, fortunately we broight our own drinks. A cold (!) small bottle of red wine, 8 euro. Strange you need to pay for this, even more strange the bottle was cold. Toilets were horrible. And of course all 4 flights had a delay. My bagage was missing for 12 days, not a single reaction from Eurowings Discover, seems to be normal? If you want to arrive relaxed at your destination, please skip Eurowings discover.
reviews.author: CarloZ

reviews.title: So much illegal behaviour from staff
reviews.text: We ticked 'Special assistance required' as we were travelling with our disable child. No assistance was available throughout any of the airport process, or on board. Further more, they decided to split our disable child with the seat allocation. There are huge safeguarding issues here sitting a non-verbal child between two strangers away from familiar parents. We were given no opportunity to train the strangers on changing his feeding tube / cleaning him etc. On board we also noticed an issue with staff serving nuts to a passenger next to a nut allergic traveller. Despite them raising several concerns. They're the headlines, but the whole process was a s*it-show. I arrived to the desk with 'Eurowings Check In' displaying on the screen, and a man in a Eurowings uniform. He eyed me and my luggage suspiciously. When I said "I'd like to check in please" he looked surprised and said "This isn't a check in desk". I re-checked the screen, and the luggage conveyor belt next to him to check my own sanity, when he asked "What Airline?" I said Eurowings, to which he replied "No, that's not here".... Dressed head to toe in a Eurowings uniform. I honestly nearly asked him if we could do the interaction again, so I could film it. He directed me to some check in machines, which didn't recognise me, but I got them working eventually. Unfortunately this then came up with a "Out of ink, see assistant" message. So back we go to the Eurowings gent from the start. When I told him what had happened, his eyes lit up "Oh, excellent. I can print you those for 30euro each. That's 90 Euros. I'll also take £90 if you want, they're basically the same now aren't they?" No offer of a receipt, or any paper work, and that £90 went straight in his pocket, there's not even a till at the check in desk. The only airline that flew the route we needed so no choice. Loads of legal issues here.
reviews.author: Li S

reviews.title: No more Eurowings
reviews.text: No more with Eurowings They are just hunting you at every level to cash more money My luggage was 5 cm to big and have to pay 40€ for a 6kg hand bag Just crocks here No More Eurowings
reviews.author: Yann

reviews.title: Old Old planes
reviews.text: I made my reservations with Lufthansa airlines for business class ticket and ended up with Eurowings ( never heard of them before) Plane was old, smelly. Food was terrible. Dirty seats and tray. I would not recommend this airline to anybody not even my enemy ☹️
reviews.author: MEHRDAD M

reviews.title: Terrible experience. Reckless and inexperienced pilots.
reviews.text: What a terrible fly-by-night airline - from the flight attendants to the pilots. The pilot botched the landing 2 separate times and had to get rerouted to another airport an hour away. While flying there they maintained low altitude, flying us through storms the entire time, with personal items flying all over. Upon landing at the new location, it was discovered that the airport did not have customs and immigration, so, back to tampa on for another hour flight with the young and inexperienced pilots. All-the-while, we were offered drinks and food - but upon request, it was, we don't have that, the galley is too crowded, its too turbulent, etc etc. We were actually told that we were not allowed to take video or pictures of the disaster we were experiencing due to "privacy concerns" - what a joke. EMT's came onto the plane to remove passengers who were sick and/or injured. When we landed, nothing, no apology, no follow-up, nothing. What a poor excuse for an airline, who risks the safety of their passengers with their inexperienced pilots. Not sure of the standards in Germany, but pilots in their 30's are certainly not certified or qualified to by flying long-haul airbus a330's. If you value your safety, stay far away from this disaster of an "airline".
reviews.author: srqlp

reviews.title: Horrible indeed and rude customer service
reviews.text: This was our very first time and will be the last. The lady at the tickets services was really rude, she was not helpful and showed a very disappointing attitude. She was really happy at the end when we find out that the ticket online were cheaper than at her desk only because she said so!! The lady at self drop luggage charge us 40 uros for 5 kg checked bag!!! and refused to offer any other payment options, she said we were too late !!! I felt we were scammed by this airline and all were rude like they were giving things for free!! Never recommend nor to book a flight with the again. Don’t do our mistake!!
reviews.author: um adhari i

reviews.title: Don’t fly with them it’s not worth it!!
reviews.text: My husband booked my flight and added a checked bag for 84€ more at time of booking. So I should have been allowed one carry-on plus my one checked bag. To make my life easier I packed all I needed in my checked bag and only brought a laptop bag. When I checked in, the attendant told me that I am only allowed 1 bag in total at a weight of 12kg (24 lbs) which makes no sense at all. Normally that is the weight allotment of one's carry on luggage. My bag weighed 18kg. I paid for an additional bag when I booked the ticket but they made me pay another 84€ for the extra weight. In total I paid 168€ for my bag on top of the 314€ for the flight. They claim to be a budget airline but they will swindle you with baggage.
reviews.author: Rockstarbandit

reviews.title: Disorganised
reviews.text: First of all emailed regarding two of my party of four not being able to make the flight ,no reply ,so unable to pay extra for other people to use spare tickets ,on return flight took ages to board as the ground crew were all over the place and it became a free for all with all the confusion ,I also told the ground crew that two of my party were unable to make the flight and they some how gave my seat also to people on standby ,It’s a shame as the flight crew going and returning were excellent,if only customer service’s were half as good it would be great
reviews.author: nilecroc55

reviews.title: They’ve improved  in a year from bad to average
reviews.text: The Frankfurt ground staff has helped professionalize this airline. But EW either knowingly misrepresents its seating upgrades or agents are very ignorant about them. When paying extra for a bulkhead seat I asked repeatedly if it was bulkhead no seats in front of me, a wall or barrier?? Yes yes I was assured. At the gate I asked again. Yes yes, no seats in front of me.he said. 79 euros I paid. On board of course there were seats in front of me! I did have a little extra legroom. The seat map looked bulkhead but a little questionable. No tail change ….. my seat number was the same as I purchased. The online checkin is also buggy because of LH and EW integration issues. I tried to avoid flying these people but they’ve taken over in the eastern US. I used to be very happy with Cityline Lufthansa but sadly I do really have to re-think my choices.
reviews.author: tampatennisplayer

reviews.title: The worst airline I have ever flown with!!!
reviews.text: First and last time I will be flying with them. The landing was that bad. Multiple people were crying on the flight. Second flight was delayed by 45 minutes. No apology. Wasn’t kept up to date with what was happening. Landed. Waited an hour for any luggage to come off. 2 other flights arrived after ours and got their baggage before us. Also the plane was like a sauna
reviews.author: Dillon

reviews.title: Very positive experience!
reviews.text: After reading the very negative reviews about Eurowings, I felt very anxious to fly with them. I travelled from Birmingham, UK to Prauge which in total is about 2 hours. Online check on the app was very simple and easy to complete. When onboard all staff were friendly and approachable, and there was also plenty of leg room. Take off and landing was very smooth and there was also no delays. I took only a luggage carry on and the only downside is you do have to pay around €40. I would very much recommend Eurowings to anyone who is travelling short haul, and is taking hand luggage. Honestly couldn’t fault my experience, would definitely fly again to another short haul city destination!!
reviews.author: Laura L

reviews.title: Eurowings doesn't care
reviews.text: Eurowings is a horrible, incompetent and callously uncaring airline. We flew them from Athens to Lisbon via Dusseldorf. They misdirected our (and LOTS of other passengers) luggage in Dusseldorf. This was inexcusable. They had plenty of time for the baggage transfer. The flight to Lisbon was actually delayed! When our luggage failed to arrive in Lisbon we were sent to an abusive third party baggage tracking company that could not have cared less about out situation. Eurowings would not be bothered. They ruined our visit to Lisbon by not getting our luggage to us. Communication and support was non-existent. Our luggage finally showed up minutes before our flight home. We will never fly Eurowings again.
reviews.author: Steven W

reviews.title: Torture!
reviews.text: If you want to be uncomfortable for 9 hours, you've come to the right place. Narrow, stiff and thin seats. Enjoy fighting with your neighbor for a little place to stick your elbow? You'll love it. If you're taller than 5' 2" you'll have no place to stuff your knees other than the back of the seat in front of you, which when reclined is practically in your lap. My wife is 5'8" and I'm 6'6". She couldn't even stretch her legs when the seat in front was reclined. I was lucky no one was in front of me or I would have had to swallow my knees! As an added bonus our seats didn't even recline properly.
reviews.author: Thomas L

reviews.title: Worst food ever while flying
reviews.text: Worst food I ever had from an airline company . I’m not expecting quality food while flying but the food was served on the both flights was horrible and inedible . Please have their executives have a taste of the food is served and then we can talk about .
reviews.author: Stefanvpopa

reviews.title: Flight arrived early, dirty lavatories
reviews.text: Easy to book, manage reservation and check in online. Efficient bag dropoff. Average boarding process (on foot). Flight was less than half full. Average seat comfort. USB ports worked, but none of the power outlets did - the flight attendants didn't have a clue. Dirty and messy lavatories, which looked like they hadn't been cleaned in a while. Immigration forms distributed as passengers were disembarking (it would have made more sense to fill them out during the flight). Flight left early and arrived over 30 min early.
reviews.author: cqfp123

reviews.title: Awful service, nasty food wrapped in plastic not even on tray. Half cup of beverage. Had to pay for earbuds, soda. lugag
reviews.text: They said free lugage 3x 23 kg. Nope I had to pay extra. You cannot even track the flight. It's say unavailable check later. It was so disappointing and I paid for 1700 more then last year for 3 people with one luggage each and insurance included. Never again.
reviews.author: Eva F

reviews.title: Delays, extra payments and threats
reviews.text: Both flights (Lisbon - Cologne and back) were delayed at least an hour, rude staff and at the return, even though we paid for extra luggage, they charged My Mom for €50 and threatened to not let her embark. Telephone service is useless. Strongly recommend to avoid at all costs
reviews.author: Adjardo L

reviews.title: 20 HOURS OF DELAY, customer service doesn't exist
reviews.text: Avoid this company. Poor customer service, huge delays and no compensations. Scandalous service for a Lufthansa group member.
reviews.author: lobibo

reviews.title: My advice- Pay more and fly with someone else
reviews.text: Returning from a conference, I arrived at the airport at 4:40am for a 7:45am flight. The que was already quite long and consisted of many passengers that had already missed a flight the day before. Eventually, 3 check-in desks opened at 5:45am, covering 3 different flights. It became quickly apparent that one of the staff members was woefully undertrained. With no supervisor, the other two members of staff kept having to help him. It was 7am before my bag was checked in. I raced over to go through security which was absolute carnage. Everyone was in the same boat so nobody was given priority. Myself and dozens of other passengers missed the flight, including women with small children who had nowhere to go and were in floods of tears. I went to the EuroWings service desk with countless other people to find an alternative flight. All the flights were fully booked until the next day. Not only did I have to go and find a hotel, Eurowings said I had to pay full price for a return flight. I had no choice but to pay it. I also had to wait hours to get my luggage back and nobody at Eurowings knew where it was! The next morning I returned 4 hours before my flight and the whole process happened again. This time I made the flight with minutes to spare. The plane was fully booked but only 50% of it was occupied as, I'm guessing, most of the passengers were still stuck in the airport. Despite being at the airport over an hour earlier than the 2 hours they recommend for short-haul flights, they have denied any rensponsbility and have blamed the issues with security at the airport. I agree, the security was a nightmare, but the competency of staff at check-in was well below the service needed, and only opening 2 1/2 hours before take off is nowhere near long enough. I will never use this company again and I strongly urge anyone else to avoid at all costs.
reviews.author: Gary P

reviews.title: Female officer
reviews.text: Some of Praga airport' officers are really rude and bad-mannerer, with no explanations. 55510 female officer. An apologies is needed.
reviews.author: Daniela Vanesa M

reviews.title: Absolutely no concept of customer service
reviews.text: The routing included a change in Cologne. Upon arrival, it was necessary to go through passport control then to go through security again. Five of us bound for Berlin arrived at the gate after it had closed, We went to another gate from which another Berlin flight was leaving and were told we could not board that flight and that our bags had been taken to a luggage room. The ticketing desk informed us that we should have chosen a route with a better connection. To be fair, the Swissport agent working on behalf of Eurowings was pleasant and professional, and we were given a ticket for the next day. However, we had to pay for hotel accommodation, and we were not able to communicate that it was absolutely impossible to make the connection. Surely Eurowings should be aware of short connections and make some concession. And, be more accommodating for a missed connections and the problems it raises for passengers.
reviews.author: sbnyc

reviews.title: Flight that did not happen
reviews.text: I want to share unique experience my wife and I had with Eurowings Discover 2 months ago. I consider myself as experienced traveler, taking approximately 70 to 80 flights per year, for business and leisure, both on regular and budget airlines. I have to say I never had such experience as I had with Eurowings Discover. We traveled in Southern Africa in March and were supposed to fly from Windhoek to Victoria Falls. Due to some changes in the itinerary I had to book our flights at the last moment, one day before traveling and Eurowings Discover direct flight was the natural choice. On the 13 March I booked two tickets for 14 March, happily looking forward to exciting visit to one of the World’s natural wonders. Booking and payment were made on Lufthansa website. I completed web checkin straight away and received boarding passes. Merely two hours later the company which was supposed to arrange our airport transfer in the morning called and informed that the Eurowings Discover flight was cancelled. The man in charge said that this was info he received from his other clients, Germans, who were booked on same flight. I at first did not believe this and I called Eurowings in Germany to double check this disturbing information. Very pleasant lady, after I was informed that the call is recorded for quality control purposes, advised and then reconfirm that g to be flight remains on schedule and, in case of any change, I will be informed via email. I call transport company again questioning their advice about flight cancellation and was informed that information about cancellation came from the travel agent in Germany. After considering all options, including chances of being stuck in Namibia and ruining our holiday, I booked other flights through Johannesburg, just as a precaution. When we came to Windhoek airport next morning, Eurowings Discover flight was not shown in the schedule of departing flights. At all! And there was no one to give any information - Eurowings checkin desk was not manned in the morning. On completion of our journey I contacted both Lufthansa and Eurowings about compensation and received following interesting reply: Quite We are sorry for previous email we must respectfully inform you that current European regulations are not applicable to the routing travelled. The EC Regulation 261/2004 applies to all airlines operating flights within the European Union, flights departing from an EU country, as well as for flights of EU airlines from a third country into an EU country, in cases where the third country does not have contradictory regulations. Therefore, compensation in line with the above regulations is not applicable in this situation. Unquote There was also expression of hope that I would not lose confidence in Eurowings and will enjoy their services on the future. I omit the name of sender as a gesture of respect. I wrote another email to Eurowings Discover giving more details but received similar reply - bye-bye to EUR 770.- So, the lessons learned - never ever use Eurowings again. I also will be very cautious using Lufthansa in the future.
reviews.author: Sergey P

reviews.title: Huge cue and terrible service on and off board. Delays
reviews.text: Huge cues at Dusseldorf airport (even for drop off lugage only) in where somewhere half way the cue a EW employee tells you that print lugage strap first at m/vc and cue again at the end of the cue. Huge frustrations from passengers and a other EW employee tells you something different. Return flight EW9855 was operated through other company. Terrible. Delay, delay. Staff could not speak any German/English. Announcement was made via mobile phone and board speakers and way too loud. Hardly any legroom, chairs could not be moved backwards.
reviews.author: S G

reviews.title: Delay.. delayed.. delayed
reviews.text: There is no flight that goes off on time with that company doesn’t matter the destination… If you can avoid them at any cost
reviews.author: Lyuboslav Dv

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: The flight was terrible, might be the worst flight I’ve ever been on. There was a group of about 15 adults who was talking loudly and drinking beer the whole time, it was so noisy I thought I was in a beer club instead of an European flight. Just awful!
reviews.author: My Huyen D

reviews.title: Shambolic
reviews.text: I have taken this flight on Smart Fare (some attempt of premium economy) which allegedly includes priority boarding, lounge access and other “perks”. Well, it turns out that: - 90% of the passengers have either bought priority or a package/fare including it. If everybody has priority nobody has priority…you need to sort this out! - Despite catering for Lufthansa and Swiss, the lounge in VLC doesn’t have an agreement with Eurowings, so I didn’t get to enjoy that perk either. This is all somehow annoying, but not the worse by far. The EW9539 passengers have been ALONE for in the luggage pick up concourse (so it’s not that the airport was exceptionally busy) for a full hour till the first bag got delivered (from 1315 to 1415 exactly), the rest took even longer (mine got delivered at 14:25). I don’t know whose fault this is (airline, airport, handling) and I don’t care at all. The point is that in a full hour standing here like a lemon nobody’s received the courtesy of an apology, status update, PA, etc. Furthermore, there’s no amenities whatsoever in the concourse, so after the flight we’ve been left to rot there for over an hour just like that. Someone here needs to get their act together.
reviews.author: Paco Jones

reviews.title: Nerver again eurowings
reviews.text: My bag was 42x30x25cm. That is 2cm too long. Not 40x30x25cm. For that I am beeing humiliated infront of the whole plane and forced to pay 50eur. By Eurowings staff i get a pathetic invite to go back and check in my bag 10 min before departure. On a more negative note the flight is just 20 minuters late, right now. To conclude, i hare eurowings and Will avoid it from now on.
reviews.author: Johan F

reviews.title: I'm furious at Lufthansa!!
reviews.text: I paid Lufthansa for a flight from Philly to Berlin via Frankfurt. Then they switched me to their el-cheapo airline at the same price. After experiencing Eurowings Discover I'm temped to call my lawyer! This carrier is the pits. Their A330s are old and dismal. The entertainment system is the worst I've ever used. Just lame. The meals seem to be what they hand out to poor refugees. Tiny and tasteless. If you want to be uncomfortable for 7 hours, you've come to the right place. Narrow, stiff and thin seats. Enjoy fighting with your neighbor for a little place to stick your elbow? You'll love it. If you're taller than 5' 2" you'll have no place to stuff your knees other than the back of the seat in front of you, which when reclined is practically in your lap. And Lufthansa scheduled the connecting flight from Frankfurt to Berlin so tight and so far away in the abyss that is Frankfurt Airport that a good portion of the passengers MISSED their flight when half of the passport control agents simply got up and walked away. They had to wait hours for another one with available seats! That's absurd. Pro Tip: Avoid Frankfurt at all costs if you have to catch a connecting fight. Bottom line: I don't care if Eurowings Discover offered me a trip back to Germany for $3.95. I'd pass just to save my sanity. That Philadelphia International Airport would give them a dedicated berth and slot says either they don't care or are too stupid to know this isn't a good thing. Lesson learned. BTW: I'd give Eurowings Discover a 1 but I'm a kind man. I won't give Lufthansa any more business since they obviously don't care about their customers. Next time I'll take Delta.
reviews.author: ErnieTech

reviews.title: Lack of Customer Service & Care
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I had just arrived at the airport for my flight when suddenly, my original flight changed. This wasn’t even a delay! Suddenly, I was now flying a completely different route, on a completely different airline, on a different day. So, to start off this poor experience they failed to inform their customers in a timely manner about these big changes. Next my new flight was booked for 5:30am the following morning. Eventually I was assisted at the Eurowings Discover desk and managed to get booked into a hotel about 10 minutes away from the hotel. The next morning, I had to make sure I was at the airport in time for my flight, meaning I had to wake up at 3am (bear in mind I only got to the hotel room at around 9 pm the night before). Leaving this early meant I missed my complimentary breakfast and I had to pay for my own transport back to the airport as the hotel’s shuttle service was not yet operational. After successfully flying with the new airline, Delta, I arrived at my first destination. After arriving at my connecting destination, I had an 11–hour layover where I had to try keep myself occupied (thanks to the Eurowings Discovers fantastic new flight itinerary they chose for me – sarcasm!). Once arriving at my final destination, I voiced my poor experience to Eurowings Discovers customer care. 1 MONTH LATER I received a really promising response from them in which they apologized for their poor service delivery as well as offering me compensation to the amount of which they thought was sufficient. I must say I was very happy with the compensation offer they had proposed, and I accepted their apology. They asked me to send through my banking details so that they could transfer the money into my account. After responding to their email, I sent through the required information, only to get one last slap in the face from this joke of an airline. I receive an email saying, “We are sorry for previous email we must respectfully inform you that current European regulations are not applicable to the routing travelled.” This after initially receiving a contradictory email which said quite the opposite - “In accordance with applicable EU regulations, we would like to offer you compensation in the amount of…” I am not sure where to take this further because the responses I have received from their customer relations department have lacked proper explanations and are extremely contradictory. One thing for sure though, if this if how they are going to deal with this situation, I can confidently say that I will never recommend, nor will I ever fly with then again in my life
reviews.author: Jared M

reviews.title: The premium economy seats are closer together than the economy seats.
reviews.text: The premium economy seats are closer together than the economy seats. I could not even open my tray table to eat. let alone get out of my seat to go to the bathroom. I complained and was answered exactly ONE YEAR later, with a compensation of 50 euros. (the ticket was 1300)! The images will tell all the story.
reviews.author: Denis L

reviews.title: Airlinses are getting worse and worse
reviews.text: They suck. Charging insane amounts for small backpack, delaying flights regularly. Not recommended - just in emergencies...
reviews.author: Andrzej M

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: Cancelation and tirp management is made almost impossible by design Cheap company, strongly advise against using it if you have a need to be even remotely flexible
reviews.author: raw f

reviews.title: Cancelled flight
reviews.text: The flight I was supposed to take was cancelled and i was notified last minute right before i was about to take bus to the airport. I lost an hour to get to the bus and 25€ for a bus ticket that I did not use. I wrote a request for a refund for my wasted bus ticket, 2 months passed, they didn't even bother to reply. I don't recomment this carrier to anyone. Frequent strikes and poor customer service.
reviews.author: Aram i

reviews.title: Avoid to get better value for your money
reviews.text: The company's business plan seems to be misleading customers into thinking they are a low-cost airline, and then throw an array of extra fees at you at the boarding gate when it's too late to regret. The personnel will give you arbitrary reasons why your tiny carry-on baggage is not suitable to place under the seat, and charge you 50€ extra. My flight was apparently delayed because of the long queue of angry people trying to clear various extra fees at the gate. I then suffered through my flight on a half-empty plane cramped in a small space with no leg room, without even water being available at a tolerable price. You will be much better off with the traditional low-cost airlines, where the fees are at least transparent and you know what to expect. You will get better value for your money even with the big national airlines that offer you comfort and service. I will not be flying Eurowings in the future.
reviews.author: Suupala

reviews.title: Sweden
reviews.text: Do not flay with this company This is a company of thieves they charged extra for check in €15 and charged €50 for hand luggage worst service i had in my life airplanes sound like tractors and smell very bad and disgusting
reviews.author: Diaa D

reviews.title: Waiting for up to 90min at bag drop off/check in.
reviews.text: Arrive in time waiting is extreme and rather chaotic. Counters seem to be understaffed. Security check is around 15-20min.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Airport check in costs
reviews.text: I couldn’t do the online check in because I couldn’t choose a seat in the online check in portal. Normally no problem at the airport. All the other airlines - just say it didn’t work - maybe say why it didn’t work - and they print out the boarding pass for you. Not with Eurowings. They insisted that I needed to show a screenshot that I couldn’t choose the seat - which I never needed to show at any other airline. As I couldn’t they forced me to pay 15 € - totally annoying as their technical problem wasn’t my fault. My advice - not to fly with Eurowings or collect all proofs. If they don’t trust me, why should I trust them?
reviews.author: Meike K

reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text: Flight time changed twice , within 24 hours of departure. Took ages to get through , cut off 3 times , no explanation for changes given . Terrible!!
reviews.author: Daren P

reviews.title: Cancelled Flight
reviews.text: I flew with a couple airlines but so far the worst experience is with Eurowings. My flight was cancelled 24 hours before departing, so I couldn’t travel, hence there was no other options just the nearby cities, but it was way more expensive. I chose the full refund… still waiting for my money to arrive. The worst is there was no apologize for the incident just the harsh facts.
reviews.author: Dóra G

reviews.title: Got refused a service that I paid extra for.
reviews.text: I traveled with my daughter. Since we had a train to catch at our destination I wanted to make the transition as quick as possible and paid extra for an upgrade so we could bring our pocket stroller in the cabin (and so we didn't have to wait for it at the bulky luggage since i know sometimes it takes a lot of time before luggage comes out). But when we reached check-in we got told there were only ONE specific brand of stroller that was allowed in the cabin. Therefore we had to put it in the hold. There was no information about this on the website at all, even the check-in staff could confirm this and they told me to contact costumer service and I will get a refund. It's now been a month since I contacted Eurowings about this (actually I contacted them twice) but I get no response. I think it's unacceptable to promote for a service and make you pay for it and then not follow through. I was basically told "We know you paid for this service, but we will not give it to you". I don't understand what kind of values a company has that treat paying costumers this way and then can't even get back to them and set things right.
reviews.author: Ulrika B

reviews.title: Refusing refund for services not delivered
reviews.text: Eurowings lost my baggage and only returned it to me three days later, well after my return from the weekend trip. They had charged 40 Euros extra for transporting my luggage, moreover I spent countless hours trying to communicate with them to get my luggage back. To add insult to injury, Eurowings now refuse to refund the 40 Euros which I paid for this service that they did not deliver, referencing the Montreal convention for "delayed baggage". My baggage wasn't delayed, it was not transported at all! I can't think of any other business that would refuse to provide a refund for a service that they were unable to deliver. Until the passenger rights regulations of the EU are amended to cover the case of failure to provide a paid extra service, I can only conclude that Eurowings think of me as cattle to be milked rather than a valued customer.
reviews.author: Gerhard E

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: This airline only allows a laptop bag onboard. This is the only airline with these standards. Crooks. 50 euros for an additional bag. I will never fly with eurowings again.
reviews.author: Ernesto Alonzo

reviews.title: Worst company ever
reviews.text: I purchased a second cabin bag but they made pay an additional fee (50€) for 1cm. Never again. Band of crooks.
reviews.author: Traveler

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE - DO NOT FLIGHT EURO WING DISCOVERY
reviews.text: I booked a flight to Italy from Orlando, FL. I made the reservation with Lufthansa and I ended up flying in Euro Wings Discovery and I had the worse experience ever I filed a claim for 900.00 Euros as follows, I paid seat C18 $85.00 Florida to Frankfurt and seat was given to another person. I paid 14 Euros from Frankfurt to Venice for seat C18 and was given 028B. At the Frankfurt airport they wanted me to pay a new ticket to Venice again even though it was not my fault for missing my flight to Venice. (They just departed 2 hours late from Florida which it seem they are popular for always departing late or cancel their flights at the last minute. I explain I suffer from Panic Atacks and Claustofhobia and they refuse to honor my Doctors letter at the Orlando counter. I called several times and they told they will not accept my letter so That's how I ended up paying $100.00 for both seat that was given to someone else. From Frankfurt to Italy I also had paid for seat C18 and they gave me 028B which is a middle seat. The passenger that was in the isle next to my sit was courteous enough to give me his seat seeing I was about to have a panic attack and he sat in the middle. I called the night before to find out the charge for an overweight luggage and they told me it was $35.00 for up to 70 pounds. My luggage weight was 60 pounds, (10 Lbs over) and your supervisor, (Mr. Chadwick), at the Orlando counter laughed at my face and charged me $370.00 for my luggage. A co worker at the check in counter told me she has never seen anybody paying so much money for an overweight and gave me his name to report him. My brand new luggage was completely destroyed by this Airline. I had extra expenses while waiting in Frankfurt as lunch, and a drink plus inecesary stress. My claim is for 900 Euros. I received an email from Mr. CAMAL apologizing asking me for my Bank account to transfer my refund but never mention how much he was going to transfer. I responded explaining the amount of money I lost he just simply disappear and after 3 emails to him he never responded again. I have no option but to file a filed a claim with the Better Business Bureau in the United States, which they will help me if not I will hire an attorney upon my arrival to the U.S. Their food is disgusting and they are so cheap you will not even get a headset to watch a movie which are old movies. At dinner time I had to pay $8,00 for a glass of wine which all airlines give it to you complementary. And this is not a low cost airline I paid close to $1000.00 for my flight to have the worse experience in my life. Think twice before booking with them.
reviews.author: Lourdes R

reviews.title: unprofessional check-in staff at Palma Mallorca Airport
reviews.text: It was really stressful check-in and boarding with three small kids just because of unprofessional check-in staff at Palma Airport(flying to back to Munich after vacation). One of us having Group I Class Ticket but she was looking at other tickets and constantly denied our request to check all tickets and forced us to pay for 23Kgs check-in for our 7 kgs cabin baggage mentioning only Group I ticket can carry this bag. The worst point is she does not want to trust EuroWings Mobile App when we showed her on our Mobile and she said to us she cant see the same in her System. I wish they are little open to communication with customers.

reviews.title: rude employee at the checkin counter
reviews.text: had bad experience with your staff at mallorca airport-they dont want to see the euro wings app boarding passes where i did buy a cabin bag and upgraded to group1 and the others travelling with me were on group2. she says you all are in group 2 and cannot tave cabin . so took money from me, printed boarding passes and then there it is clearly written group 1. cannot belive this and was hope less . never after
reviews.author: chakradhar p

reviews.title: Do not fly with this airline...
reviews.text: I booked a flight from London Heathrow - Vienna, with a change in Stuttgart. Both of these flights were operated by Eurowings. As I was waiting in London Heathrow for my flight, I heard an announcement that the flight was going to be late. This reduced the amount of time I had to make my connecting flight from Stuttgart to Vienna. I pre-emptively raised this issued with customer services for Lufthansa Group (to which Eurowings belongs) at London Heathrow, as Eurowings does not have a presence in the airport and the Eurowings customer service number does not work in the UK. I also pre-emptively raised this issue with the boarding gate crew and a stewardess on the flight. All three of these, employed by Eurowings or associated with Eurowings, said that I will make the connecting flight and it will wait for me. Woe and behold, I did not... No effort was made on my behalf by these members of staff. In the end, I was only 8-minutes late for boarding in Stuttgart. Having literally ran through the airport to try and make the connection, I arrived at the gate before departure of the flight, but was denied boarding by a Eurowings staff member, who had a rude attitude which insinuated I was lazy and purposefully late. I suffered over a 90-minute inbound delay by Eurowings and a member of staff couldn't ring forward to hold the outbound plane? Passenger Rights re-booked me onto a morning flight (06:40 with boarding at 06:10) with paid accommodation for the night, however, by the time I reached the accommodation, settled down and reviewed the re-booking procedure, it was midnight. The re-booking procedure had not gone smoothly as my boarding pass QR code was unable to be generated on the Eurowings app or website. This meant I had to arrive even earlier at the airport to ensure a boarding pass was printed. The re-booked morning flight was late by an hour... The only significant aid I received during this whole debacle was from Passenger Rights. Do not fly with this airline!
reviews.author: Joshua

reviews.title: Worst business class every flown
reviews.text: This business class flight was the worst we have every experienced and we fly a lot! It started at the airport in Male, Maldives. We were informed that Eurowings Discovery does not pay for lounge access. Every other airline at the airport had access. We had to pay 45 USD per person to enter the lounge! The staff had no organisation. Nothing was done in an orderly fashion. Meal service was incredibly slow and some people were even forgotten. The entertainment system stopped working several times during the 11 hour flight. I had to search the plane for a flight attendant to find toilet paper for the toilets in business class. There was trash from the previous flight on the floor around my seat. Honestly, the list goes on and on.
reviews.author: BordeauxPeanut
